sample_unit: anesthetist raters evaluating 3 leaflets (7 FAQs each)

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of patient education materials versus sixth-grade target
links.effect: DPIL had highest readability, followed by ChatGPT, Gemini lowest; all materials exceeded the recommended sixth-grade readability level.
links.quote: All materials exceeded the recommended sixth-grade readability level.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of AI-generated patient education materials
links.effect: All materials, including ChatGPT and Gemini outputs, exceeded sixth-grade readability; Gemini responses often considered linguistically complex by parents.
links.quote: Gemini responses were often considered linguistically complex.

links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of AI-generated leaflets rated by blinded anesthetists
links.effect: No significant differences in accuracy or completeness among DPIL, ChatGPT, and Gemini (p > 0.05); authors recommend clinician review of AI content.
links.quote: No significant differences were observed in accuracy or completeness among the three sources (p > 0.05).

unlisted_practices: Comparing chatbot-generated patient education to clinician-authored leaflets on sentiment and parental satisfaction

screen.reason: The study empirically compares LLM-generated patient education materials (ChatGPT and Gemini) against traditional clinician-authored departmental leaflets for readability, accuracy, completeness, sentiment, and parental satisfaction.
